generated_by: Fixed parity cases generated during development from the Python implementation (skid/route_edit.py, skid/clearance.py), then extended with review regression cases; the original generator scripts are not included. Values are frozen expected outputs. See docs/FIXTURE_PROVENANCE.md.
comparison: exact: points_m and section numbers compare with ===; refusals compare error codes only

cases.name: current47_l105_riser_clear
cases.note: Actual revision-47 L-105 (conn-discharge-3) with the C-101 body boxes: moving the riser 0.4 m towards the valve clears the vessel; leg 0 shortens and a connector is added before leg 2.

cases.name: current47_l105_top_leg_blocked
cases.note: Moving the top leg alone leaves leg 0 inside C-101: refused.

cases.name: current47_l105_inlet_leg_stub
cases.note: The 0.16 m terminal leg into the C-101 inlet cannot keep a 0.16 m stub.

cases.name: interior_stretch_both
cases.note: Interior +y leg moved along x: both adjacent x legs stretch/shrink, no new points.

cases.name: interior_connector
cases.note: Interior +y leg moved along z: a z connector is added at each end.

cases.name: interior_reversed_offset
cases.note: Negative offset: leg 0 shortens, leg 2 lengthens.

cases.name: terminal_start
cases.note: First leg moved: fixed 0.16 m stub at the start port, then a connector.

cases.name: terminal_end
cases.note: Last leg moved along its neighbour's axis: the neighbour shrinks, 0.16 m stub at the end port.

cases.name: straight_both_stubs
cases.note: A single straight leg between facing ports: stubs at both ends and a parallel offset run.

cases.name: collinear_and_duplicate_input
cases.note: Repeated point and a collinear split are simplified first: same sections as interior_connector.

cases.name: u_bend_interior
cases.note: Top of a U raised: both risers stretch.

cases.name: adjacent_leg_cancelled_merges
cases.note: Raising leg 1 by exactly leg 2's length cancels leg 2; legs 1 and 3 then merge into one +y leg.

cases.name: insufficient_bend_room
cases.note: A 50 mm connector cannot hold a bend larger than the pipe radius.

cases.name: terminal_reverses_port_tangent
cases.note: The first leg would run backwards out of the start port.

cases.name: stub_too_short
cases.note: Terminal leg shorter than the fixed stub.

cases.name: self_clearance
cases.note: Lowering leg 4 to 50 mm above leg 0 (bend room is ample) leaves them closer than one OD.

cases.name: synthetic_body_blocks
cases.note: Offset run 0.1 m sideways still passes through the block.

cases.name: synthetic_body_cleared
cases.note: Offset 0.4 m clears the block.

cases.name: r48_l105_riser_tiny_positive
cases.note: Main revision-48 L-105: the riser's upstream leg runs along the offset axis and stretches, and the 1e-7 m connector would merge in simplify, leaving only drift: refused below 1 mm.

cases.name: r48_l105_riser_tiny_negative
cases.note: Negative sub-millimetre offset: refused below 1 mm.

cases.name: r48_l105_riser_just_below_1mm
cases.note: 0.999 mm: refused below 1 mm.

cases.name: r48_l105_riser_exact_1mm
cases.note: Exactly +1 mm is admissible; it then meets the geometric limits (a 1 mm connector has no bend room).

cases.name: interior_stretch_tiny
cases.note: Both adjacent legs run along the offset axis (no connector): 0.5 mm refused below 1 mm.

cases.name: interior_stretch_exact_1mm
cases.note: Exactly +1 mm with stretching neighbours: moved; the stored points change by exactly 1 mm.

cases.name: interior_stretch_exact_minus_1mm
cases.note: Exactly -1 mm with stretching neighbours: moved.

cases.name: tiny_parallel_offset
cases.note: A tiny offset along the section's own axis stays route_edit_offset_parallel.

cases.name: tiny_two_axis_offset
cases.note: Two tiny nonzero components stay route_edit_invalid_offset.
